rolecall-sync.Settings.ApiBaseUrl.Name: RoleCall API base URL
rolecall-sync.Settings.ApiBaseUrl.Hint: RoleCall server origin. Leave the default unless you self-host.
rolecall-sync.Settings.ApiToken.Name: RoleCall API token
rolecall-sync.Settings.ApiToken.Hint: Filled automatically by Connect to RoleCall, or paste a token from your game's Tokens page. It identifies which game's scenes are pulled. Stored in this browser only, so it is never shared with your players — you will need to connect again on another computer.
rolecall-sync.Settings.Connect.Name: Connect to RoleCall
rolecall-sync.Settings.Connect.Label: Connect to RoleCall
rolecall-sync.Settings.Connect.Hint: Link this Foundry client to a RoleCall campaign — sign in (or create a free account) in your browser and the token is set up for you. No copy-paste.
rolecall-sync.Settings.SyncNow.Name: Sync now
rolecall-sync.Settings.SyncNow.Label: Sync from RoleCall
rolecall-sync.Settings.SyncNow.Hint: Pull this game's scenes and campaign lore notes from RoleCall into journal entries.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Overlay.Title: Connect to RoleCall
rolecall-sync.Connect.Overlay.LeadPopup: Finish connecting in the browser tab that just opened.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Overlay.LeadBlocke: Your browser blocked the popup — open the link below to continue.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Overlay.VerifyCode: If the code shown there doesn't match the one above, stop.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Error.RateLimited: Too many connect attempts — wait a few minutes and retry.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Error.OutOfDate: This module version is out of date — update RoleCall Sync.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.GmOnly: RoleCall: only a GM can connect this world.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.NoBaseUrl: RoleCall: set the API base URL in module settings first.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.OpenUrl: RoleCall: open {url} to approve the connection.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.Denied: RoleCall: the connect request was denied on the website.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.Consumed: RoleCall: that connect request was already used — start again.
rolecall-sync.Connect.Notify.Expired: RoleCall: the connect request expired — click Connect again.
rolecall-sync.Notify.GmOnly: RoleCall: only a GM can sync this world.
rolecall-sync.Notify.FolderFailed: RoleCall: couldn't create the journal folders — see the console.
rolecall-sync.Notify.NothingToSync: RoleCall: nothing to sync — no scenes or lore notes in "{name}" yet.
rolecall-sync.Notify.NothingLanded: RoleCall: couldn't write anything from this sync — see the console for what failed.
rolecall-sync.Notify.SyncedWithLore: RoleCall: synced {scenes} and {lore} to Journal Entries → "{folder}"
rolecall-sync.Api.NoBaseUrl: Set the RoleCall API base URL in module settings.
rolecall-sync.Api.NoToken: Paste a RoleCall API token in module settings.
rolecall-sync.Api.Unauthorized: Invalid or revoked token — check module settings.
rolecall-sync.Api.MalformedResponse: RoleCall sent a response this module couldn't read — check the API base URL in module settings.
rolecall-sync.Api.VersionTooNew: RoleCall has moved to sync format {server}; this module only understands {expected}. Update the RoleCall module, then sync again.
rolecall-sync.Api.VersionTooOld: RoleCall is on sync format {server}; this module expects {expected}. Syncing anyway — some prep may be missing.
